dialogue.text: I am Apep, serpent of chaos.

dialogue.speaker: apep
dialogue.text: Each night I devour the sun.

dialogue.speaker: thor
dialogue.text: I am Thor, son of Odin.

dialogue.speaker: thor_hoarse
dialogue.text: Never sleep under a dark sun.

sentences.speaker: apep
sentences.text: I am Apep, serpent of chaos.

sentences.speaker: apep
sentences.text: Each night I devour the sun.

sentences.speaker: apep
sentences.text: Tonight, I devour you.

sentences.speaker: thor
sentences.text: I am Thor, son of Odin.

sentences.speaker: thor
sentences.text: I hooked the World Serpent.

sentences.speaker: thor
sentences.text: Crawl back, worm.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A kid slept at the desert's edge, until a hiss called their name.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: So they walked out beneath an eclipse.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then Apep rose, and the world shook.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But thunder fell first, and Thor caught the strike on his hammer.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The kid ran for the ruins.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He buckled his belt, and his strength doubled.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His hammer never misses.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But Apep roared, so the sand split and the dunes buckled.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then its stare froze him, and the coils closed in.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Venom burned through his veins, so he staggered, step after step.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Now the eclipse reached totality, and darkness swallowed the ruins.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Thor roared back with lightning, yet the chaos beam pushed harder.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: So he tore an ox head from the old altar, and hooked it to his hammer as bait.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Apep lunged for the bait, and Thor's lightning blasted it skyward.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The beast spat out the dark, and sunlight spilled across the sand.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The kid stood on the sand again, though their shadow had changed.

sentences.speaker: thor_hoarse
sentences.text: Go home, little one.

sentences.speaker: thor_hoarse
sentences.text: Never sleep under a dark sun.

sentences.speaker: kid
sentences.text: ...Okay.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At the next sunset, the dunes began to breathe.

sentences.speaker: apep_whisper
sentences.text: I always come back.
